executable_actions.rationale: The earliest current-layer failure is missing complete-scope real-weight binding, before any executable board AXI/DDR trace. Repair only the exact-board multilayer loader/harness and its binding evidence so every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer has immutable catalog hash, binding path, and executed DUT-consumption witness. Preserve the checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference outputs, comparison policy/tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper/simulation identities. Do not add model-tail tensors, alter golden outputs, loosen numeric policy, or rerun the certified connected kernel.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline executed and failed with multilayer_real_weight_binding: the DUT binding does not cover every Transformer-block weight in every target layer. The dependent board AXI/DDR, VCS, analyzer, deadlock, ordering, numeric, and semantic-evidence tools are not-run and therefore provide no functional or hardware-failure localization.

Contract-guided debug closure classifies the present blocker as verification_semantic_capability_contract, has no failed boundary records, no root RTL candidate, and explicitly blocks hardware boundary tracing until the semantic loader/weight-binding capability is repaired.

Operator-leaf and connected single-layer gates passed. The hash-bound connected-kernel evidence records complete ingress and egress of 1792 beats, terminal egress-last, 416 accepted boundary records, and boundary liveness pass. No current trace directly contradicts these certified invariants, so the completed connected-kernel replay is closed.
The conditional design-team review is no_split and adds no specialist action that could replace deterministic gate evidence.

sacg_memory_truth reports 17 active contamination barriers and six open retries in this board scope. In particular, retry_request.0136 and retry_request.0140 remain open for the current multilayer-pipeline/functional failure. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning evidence only and cannot promote the design; this candidate action supplies only fresh evidence for later Stage7 reconciliation.

Earlier active barrier records concerning board-interface discovery or AXI/DDR identity remain downstream trust barriers, but they do not supersede the current decisive prerequisite failure. They must not be treated as passed, and they are not a reason to bypass the multilayer binding gate.
proposed_actions: Perform one bounded exact-board multilayer loader/harness binding repair: reconcile the complete immutable Transformer-block tensor catalog against the exact-board DUT loader binding, generate hash-bound per-tensor coverage and executed-consumption evidence, and rerun only case_multilayer_pipeline. Return the resulting current-layer report to Stage7; do not run a connected-kernel replay, functional simulation, or backend flow as part of this action.
risks: Model and weight risk: a partial catalog, sampled tensors, or a manifest not bound to the exact immutable checkpoint can falsely claim coverage. The repair must enumerate all required Transformer-block tensors across all target layers, while excluding embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling.

Harness/runtime risk: a manifest on disk is insufficient unless the exact-board loader/harness is bound to it and an executed checker proves all required tensors were consumed by the DUT path; missing entries must not be synthesized, defaulted, or inferred from RTL output.

Numeric and stimulus risk: target-model expected outputs, input provenance, frozen comparison policy, and tolerance must remain unchanged. No random expected outputs, DUT-derived expected outputs, or tolerance adjustment is permitted.

Board integration risk: exact user-supplied board wrapper and simulation source identities must remain hash-bound. This action must not substitute a simplified AXI/DDR wrapper or guess board/Vivado targets.

Cross-layer risk: a future board frontier stall, prefetch observation, or AXI progress alone cannot invalidate the elastic connected-kernel certificate. Reopening it requires a new hash-bound current trace with direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current-certificate contradiction evidence.

Promotion risk: even a passing targeted multilayer binding rerun is not a board functional pass and cannot clear the active contamination barriers or allow backend, bitstream, runtime-ABI, or board-runtime promotion.

artifacts: artifact.stage7.verification_result and artifact.stage8.repair_plan active contamination barriers

checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes remain immutable
lower-layer reopening requires a current hash-bound trace that directly contradicts a named certified invariant
accelerator semantic scope is Transformer blocks only

This is a verification-capability and board-integration binding failure, not RTL-core evidence. Do not request a hardware boundary trace until this semantic capability gate passes; do not reopen or rerun the certified connected-kernel replay.
